lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Closed the CRITICAL review round 1 finding on src/tmux/dispatch.ts's geometry oracle (US-002/US-R1-001, CAM-359): a real Ink composer pins cursor_y CONSTANT (grows upward from the pane bottom -- confirmed both by the PRD's own real-TUI measurement and by fetching tmux's format.c, which shows cursor_x/cursor_y come straight from the pane's base screen cursor coordinates, the SAME coordinate space capture-pane -p's line order uses), so cursor_x mod paneWidth was the ONLY positional discriminator in production, and being a modulo it is inherently periodic: a payload whose length is an exact multiple of paneWidth lands the wrapped cursor back on the exact baseline column, colliding on BOTH axes and misreporting an undelivered push as delivered. Added `composerLineRetainsPayloadTail` (dispatch.ts) as a content backstop: it fires ONLY when `geometryUnchanged` already reads true (the ambiguous branch), and anchors a trailing-suffix match (endsWith, length 8 down to a floor of 2) of the just-sent text against the captured pane row AT the reported cursor_y -- narrower than a whole-payload substring search (which the module header already rejected for a different reason: a wrapped payload never appears whole on one line), so it doesn't reopen that forgery/anchor-collision concern. `sendKeysVerified`'s attempt loop now calls `capture(paneId)` an extra time only in that ambiguous branch (no extra tmux round trip on the common, already-discriminating-by-geometry path). test/fixtures/dispatch-geometry/raw-echo.ts was rewritten from an eager-downward-wrap model (cursor_y incrementing on row-fill, the model the reviewer flagged as not matching production) to a bottom-anchored, pinned-cursor_y model with a 2-char '> ' prompt (matching the PRD's measured empty-composer cursorX=2) laid out via computeRows/render, redrawing the whole screen from a fixed ANCHOR_ROW on every byte; it now takes a paneHeight argv (test/integration/dispatch-geometry.test.ts's bootPane passes it). Two NEW real-tmux integration tests (length===PANE_WIDTH, already covered by the corrected AC8 pair, and a second one at length===2*PANE_WIDTH) both pass against a REAL tmux server, proving the fix closes the gap empirically, not just via mocked unit tests. Also added 2 new sendKeysVerified unit tests (scripted geometry-collision + content-remnant vs content-cleared) and a dedicated composerLineRetainsPayloadTail unit describe block (7 tests: remnant present/absent, 2-char minimum match, 1-char below floor, out-of-range cursorY, empty text, trailing-whitespace trim). Raised file-size-budget.json ceilings for the two files this story grew (dispatch.ts 451->534, test/dispatch.test.ts 571->676); did not touch any other budgeted file. No open threads for the next story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed cursor_x/cursor_y format variables read directly from the pane's base screen cursor coordinates (wp->base.cx/cy) -- the same coordinate space capture-pane's line order uses -- validating that indexing capture-pane output by the sampled cursor_y is sound. Also confirmed (via tmux issue tracker / docs) that capture-pane -p strips trailing whitespace per line by default (no -N/-J), matching the defensive trim in composerLineRetainsPayloadTail.
